title: Blog moderation

feeds.label: Post lists
feeds.note: Pin and newsfeed buttons appear for staff who hold those permissions.

hide.title: Hide “{title}”?
hide.body: The post leaves the feed and this list. Only its authors and staff can open it by its link.

contestLocked: The official contest is running and the blog is locked, so posts cannot be hidden or shown yet.

unhide.title: Show this post again?
unhide.now: The post shows at once in the feed and in the public lists.
unhide.ahead: The publish time is still ahead. The post moves to the Scheduled tab and shows in the feed only from {time}, not at once.

hiddenNote: Hidden posts are not in the feed; only their authors and staff can open them.

search.placeholder: Title text or exact author username

bulk.confirmTitle: Hide {count} posts? | Hide {count} post? | Hide {count} posts?
bulk.confirmBody: They leave every list but stay reachable by link for their authors and staff. Each can be shown again from the hidden list.
